text: I ordered a size medium jacket and it arrived two sizes too small. The sizing chart on your website is completely wrong. I need a refund immediately.
The quality of this dress is incredible. The fabric feels luxurious and the stitching is perfect. I've already ordered two more in different colors!
Your shipping took 3 weeks and the shirt arrived with a massive stain on it. This is unacceptable. I'm disputing the charge with my credit card company.
I love the new autumn collection! The earth tones are beautiful. Wish you had more plus size options though — I couldn't find anything above XL.
Bought these jeans last month and they're already falling apart at the seams. I paid $89 for jeans that lasted 4 weeks. Never buying from you again.
The return process was so easy! I changed my mind about the color and the exchange was handled in 2 days. Your customer service team is fantastic.
I've been trying to cancel my subscription for 3 months and keep getting charged. I've sent 5 emails with no response. I'm going to contact the BBB.
The linen pants are perfect for summer. Light, breathable, and the color hasn't faded after 10 washes. Would love to see more linen options.
My order arrived damaged — the buttons on the blazer were broken and the packaging was destroyed. Looks like it was dropped multiple times.
Finally a brand that gets sustainable fashion right. The recycled fabric collection is gorgeous and I feel good knowing it's eco-friendly.
The hoodie shrunk two sizes after one wash even though I followed the care instructions exactly. This is a manufacturing defect.
I've been a loyal customer for 5 years but your recent price increases with no quality improvement are pushing me to shop elsewhere.
The fit guide recommendation was spot on! I'm usually between sizes and it suggested the larger size which was perfect. Great tool.
Received the wrong item entirely — ordered a blue cardigan, got a red skirt. Now I have to wait another 2 weeks for the correct item.
Your workout leggings are the best I've ever worn. No see-through, stays in place, and the pockets actually fit my phone!
The color online looked like a deep burgundy but in real life it's bright pink. Very disappointed with the photo accuracy.
My package was marked delivered but never arrived. The tracking shows it was left at the wrong address. I need this resolved urgently.
The new denim line is exactly what I was looking for — high waist, good stretch, and it doesn't gap at the back. Please keep making these!
Customer service hung up on me when I called about a defective zipper. This is the worst shopping experience I've had.
I bought a gift for my daughter and she absolutely loves it. The packaging was beautiful too — felt like a luxury brand experience.
